moduleResponsibilityEvidence.responsibilityBoundary: Combines client-scoped article, trash, lifecycle, attention and platform reads into one revisioned read-only management projection; it does not write lifecycle facts or own queue/order transitions.
moduleResponsibilityEvidence.minimumCapability: Client-scoped read capabilities for articles, trash, batches, lifecycle facts, attention, transactions and platforms.
dependencyDirection: desktop IPC → article management snapshot service → content/lifecycle read capabilities
snapshot service → src/content/article-lifecycle-projection domain bridge; no renderer or Electron transport dependency
hiddenInvariants: Client identity is validated and publication/order records are client-scoped
Revision cache is read-only and stale reads retry once
Each required persistence category is read through one injected batch capability
moduleResponsibilityEvidence.scaleChangeReason: No production module size change in 25-F; benchmark fixture grows to the frozen 2,000-article/2,000-order scale to exercise the existing batch seam.

moduleResponsibilityEvidence.responsibilityBoundary: Coordinates queue-group execution, platform lock admission and outcome application while exposing the persisted group/current/remaining read projection; it does not own persistence facts, article lifecycle classification or external adapter policy.
moduleResponsibilityEvidence.minimumCapability: Named regular queue transition ports and a narrow platform submission preparation capability.
dependencyDirection: content IPC/feature → regular queue orchestrator → regular queue transition capability
orchestrator → domain prepared-submission contract and outcome service; adapter does not own lifecycle state
hiddenInvariants: snapshot reads all groups and their FIFO current/remaining projection through one batch capability
Platform lock scope keeps same-platform account groups serial and different platforms independent
Uncertain outcomes freeze the original attempt and are never replayed automatically
moduleResponsibilityEvidence.scaleChangeReason: No production module size change in 25-F; the benchmark uses 8 frozen groups and 400 queue items to test current/remaining projection without per-item reads.

moduleResponsibilityEvidence.responsibilityBoundary: Maps persisted order observations into safe application order views and owns observation/query result mapping; it does not own paid-batch scheduling, lifecycle projection or supplier credentials.
moduleResponsibilityEvidence.minimumCapability: Order observation transition ports; supplier capability is required only for explicit sync commands, not list projection.
dependencyDirection: media workbench application → media order service → order observation transition ports
service → domain order observation validator and safe DTO; supplier adapter is used only by sync commands
hiddenInvariants: List projection performs no supplier transport and exposes no provider-only fields
Missing/unknown/transport-failed observations preserve facts or create explicit anomaly outcomes
Status 2 publication evidence remains authoritative over later order observations
moduleResponsibilityEvidence.scaleChangeReason: No production module size change in 25-F; 2,000 synthetic orders exercise batch listing and renderer filtering/counts with zero supplier calls.

moduleResponsibilityEvidence.responsibilityBoundary: Sorts, filters and counts safe order DTOs for the user-visible order list; it does not query persistence, refresh orders or change order facts.
moduleResponsibilityEvidence.minimumCapability: An in-memory array of safe order DTOs and optional status/search input.
dependencyDirection: OrdersView → order-list projection → safe media order DTO
projection has no desktop, Electron, persistence or supplier dependency
hiddenInvariants: Default filter is pending and counts cover every supported status
Creation-time descending order is preserved before filtering
Projection is pure and does not issue refresh or transport calls
moduleResponsibilityEvidence.scaleChangeReason: No production module size change in 25-F; the frozen 2,000-order fixture measures pure projection cost separately from the one batch persistence read.

safeEnvironmentSummary.forbidden: Do not copy process.env, request headers, cookies, tokens, API keys, provider response bodies, absolute workspace paths or raw exception messages into generated evidence.

statusSemantics.PASSED: The command's own contract checks completed with no hard failure; it is not a Ticket 25/Wave 11 audit conclusion.
statusSemantics.FAILED: A contract, hard query/scan budget or package check failed; preserve the safe failure code and exact sourceState.
statusSemantics.OBSERVED_NOT_A_FINAL_GATE: A benchmark recorded data without an approved wall-clock baseline; query/scan status remains independently visible.
statusSemantics.NOT_RUN: The entry is defined but no command was executed on this sourceState.
statusSemantics.USER_EXTERNAL_ACCEPTANCE_REQUIRED: A real account/service action is intentionally outside automation and requires later explicit authorization.

sensitivityPolicy.safeFailureRule: Use stable error codes and generic messages only; do not serialize raw errors.

externalOperations.automationPolicy: synthetic fixtures and fake/in-memory transport only
